E3 · Asset & Pattern Library

the register of reusable Patterns and qualified Assets, with explicit qualification state

Purpose

Accumulate reusable Patterns and Assets under explicit qualification discipline.

Strategy

One successful cycle is evidence, not a Pattern; qualification requires repetition, written conditions and Steward authority.

Assets

Qualified Patterns, Asset records and their qualification condition sets.

Mesh participation (all nine stages)

1 Signal — What EntersCandidate patterns and asset claims arriving from completed work.
2 InterpretationWhether a claim is narrative, candidate evidence, or meets qualification conditions.
3 StructuringPattern records with qualification state, conditions and lineage.
4 ValidationQualification condition checks and Steward qualification decisions.
5 Action PermittedRegister candidates; publish qualified Patterns for reuse by Compose.
6 ObservationReuse outcomes: where Patterns hold, where they fail.
7 LearningWhich qualification conditions predict successful reuse.
8 Asset ConversionThis Element IS the conversion gate: candidates become Assets only here, under authority.
9 Feedback Returns ToFailed reuse returns to Transform as a re-design Signal.
